info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Supplier Agreements Retrieval API
info.description: The Supplier Agreements Retrieval API allows users to access and review existing supplier agreements efficiently. This API is designed for businesses to manage their supplier relationships effectively by providing the necessary information on agreements with external agencies. Typical users include procurement teams, compliance officers, and financial analysts who need to monitor contractual obligations and terms. Utilizing this API, organizations can ensure they are aligned with supplier terms and can streamline their operations in managing supplier contracts.

get.summary: Retrieve supplier agreements for external agencies.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of supplier agreements associated with external agencies. It provides essential information about each agreement, helping users manage and view existing supplier partnerships efficiently.
